facts.rationale: Narrows the existing generic capture name to the demonstrated ReDead/Like Like enemy-capture subset. The predicate does not recognize other fighter capture motions.

evidence.why: Returns true only for motion IDs 0x14D and 0x14E.
Identifies CaptureLeadead and CaptureLikelike and shows additional capture states outside this predicate.

facts.value: Replaces a movement vector with a planar, approximately perpendicular direction derived from the supplied surface normal and selected by the sign of the direction argument. It scales that direction by the incoming vector's three-dimensional magnitude and sets Z to zero. This approximately preserves speed when the supplied normal has unit-length XY components; the helper does not normalize the normal itself. A zero direction clears the movement vector.
facts.rationale: Corrects unconditional speed-preservation wording while retaining the established terrain-tangent role. The equations scale the supplied XY components directly and include a tiny nonzero cosine-like term.

evidence.why: Shows the incoming magnitude calculation, copied unnormalized normal, sign branches, approximate quarter-turn equations, and planar output.
Confirms concrete use with item velocity, floor normal, and facing direction.
